cases.scope: Natural complete masked first-open with general composition boundary inputs
limitations: Fresh original entry and frames; no old captured state or output is reused.
Parameter, software objects, masks, names, initial SR and VERSION/MMIO words are explicit synthetic premises, not live initialization.
The actual first-open prefix, object/callback registration, getter, both slots, suspend registrar and scalar helpers execute without computational replies.
Only existing mutex/diagnostic boundaries receive literal zero r0 with no memory or SR change; no dynamic provider or physical synchronization claim.
VERSION bit6 is set and secondary is zero, so the earlier service is skipped by actual source control flow.
The real driver receives null mask source; its registrar SR derives from the preceding comparisons and is not separately supplied.
Mask low bit30 is set; the real predicate rejects before second-slot DI or any privileged service.
Opaque GP+3B484 remains supplied and is not a produced handle; the caller handle output is preserved.
IRQ/p16 observations assume no interrupt arrival and the explicit finite stream; they do not define physical lock behavior.
No SWI/RTI, service reply, model change, guessed initialization or hardware access.
